en.headline: Firefighters put out unit blaze in North Point building with no injuries
en.dek: About 40 residents self-evacuated from Yi On Building on Chun Yeung Street after a unit fire around 3:30pm; police said a short circuit was suspected.
body: Firefighters extinguished a unit fire at Yi On Building on Chun Yeung Street in North Point on Monday afternoon with no injuries reported.

Police received a report around 3:30pm from a woman who said a unit was on fire and that she and four family members had left safely. Fire services used one hose and a smoke-mask team, later deploying a ladder, and put out the blaze in about 23 minutes. About 40 residents self-evacuated.
Preliminary investigations pointed to a suspected short circuit involving a socket or computer. Roads in the area and some tram services were temporarily affected during the incident.

zh.headline: 北角宜安大廈單位起火 約40人自行疏散無人受傷
zh.dek: 春秧街大廈下午約3時半起火，消防約23分鐘撲熄；初步懷疑涉及短路。
body: 消防周一午間撲滅北角春秧街宜安大廈一個單位的火警，沒有受傷報告。
警方約下午3時半接獲一名女子報案，指單位起火，她與四名家人已安全離開。消防出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊，其後升起雲梯，約23分鐘後將火撲熄。約40名住戶自行疏散。
初步調查懷疑涉及插座或電腦短路。火警期間附近道路及部分電車服務一度受影響。
